raw: {"analysis":"Both responses address the key constraints: feature flag gating, backward compatibility for legacy cookies, mock IdP flakiness, CI cost optimization, and the required written approvals. ZGV uses a gate-based framework (G2-G9) that is also comprehensive, with slightly more emphasis on automated monitoring and auto-rollback post-deploy.
